name.description: This is the name of the simulation suite.

slackWebhookUrl.description: This is the Slack webhook URL for notifications.

simulationIds.description: This is the list of simulation IDs to include in the suite.

path.description:
Optional folder path for organizing simulation suites.
Supports up to 3 levels (e.g., "dept/feature/variant").
Maps to GitOps resource folder structure.
